content: No, the sentence "Mookie Betts took a side-step three" is not plausible. It is grammatically incorrect and nonsensical. "Side-step" is not a countable action that can be followed by a number like "three" in this context. In a baseball context, "Mookie Betts took a side-step" could be plausible as a description of a physical movement, but adding "three" makes it ungrammatical and unclear.
